name: Zagorulko Category Filters for HUSKY
author: yuriy602

sections.description:
Zagorulko Category Filters for HUSKY is a powerful extension for the HUSKY – WooCommerce Products Filter Professional (formerly WOOF). It allows you to tailor the shopping experience by showing only relevant filters on specific category pages.

By default, HUSKY displays all enabled filters across every product category. This can lead to a cluttered and confusing sidebar for your customers. For example, showing “RAM Size” filters while a customer is browsing “Footwear” is unnecessary and distracting.

This plugin solves that problem by allowing you to assign specific filters to each product category. You can also define Global Filters that remain visible across all categories, ensuring a clean, focused, and professional shopping interface.

Features

  • Category-Specific Filters: Choose exactly which filters appear for each WooCommerce category.
  • Global Filters: Set filters that should always be visible, regardless of the category being viewed.
  • Intelligent Inheritance: Subcategories automatically inherit filter settings from their parent categories, simplifying configuration.
  • Shop Page Customization: Define a unique set of filters for the main WooCommerce Shop page.
  • Performance Optimized: Uses WordPress Object Cache to ensure fast loading times and minimal database impact.
  • Multilingual Support: Fully compatible with WPML and Polylang for international e-commerce stores.
  • Import/Export Tools: Easily migrate your filter configurations between development and production environments.
sections.installation:
1. Requirement: Ensure HUSKY (WOOF) and WooCommerce are installed and activated.
  2. Upload the zagorulko-category-filters-for-husky folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  4. Navigate to Settings > Zagorulko Category Filters for HUSKY to start configuring your category filters.
sections.faq:
Does this work with the free version of HUSKY?

Yes, it is fully compatible with both the free and Professional versions of HUSKY (formerly WOOF).

Can I use it without HUSKY?

No, this plugin is an extension specifically built for the HUSKY (WOOF) filtering ecosystem and requires it to function.

Will it impact my site’s performance?

No. We’ve optimized the plugin to use the WordPress Object Cache, ensuring that filter logic is processed quickly without increasing database load.

How does category inheritance work?

If a subcategory doesn’t have its own filter configuration, the plugin automatically inherits settings from the nearest parent category. This allows you to set filters for a top-level category and have them apply to all its subcategories instantly.
